newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello sees lower jobless as economy grows.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello sees lower jobless as economy grows.

text.p: Treasurer Peter Costello said Australian unemployment will trend down as the economy grows in calendar 1997.

"As the economy grows in calendar 1997 we will get good employment growth and unemployment will trend down," Costello said in response to a question after an address to the Australian Business Economists conference.
Costello said the government had been forecasting 2.0 percent employment growth and that by the end of the 1996/97 financial year (July/June) there would be a modest fall in unemployment.
"We still believe there will be that employment growth but coming off a little higher base now than we were in June," he said.
He said earlier in a speech to the conference that the 1996/97 budget handed down in August had noted that unemployment will fall only gradually.
He said recent data on participation rates showed how difficult the task will be and that the starting point for a fall in unemployment is higher than had been anticipated in the budget.
